answer.text: Place the motorcycle upright on a level surface, start the engine from cold, let it idle for 2 to 3 minutes, then stop it.
Wait 2 to 3 minutes for the oil to settle, then check the level in the sight glass.
The oil level should be close to the MAX mark.
If the level is not there, top up the oil to MAX and repeat the procedure.
Do not fill above the MAX mark, as this may affect the clutch function.
After an oil service the manual gives a different target, between the minimum and maximum lines, so confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
